Introduction

About Me

I am a dedicated educator and linguist pursuing an M.S. in Communication Science & Disorder at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, building on a perfect 4.0 GPA in my M.A. in Applied English Linguistics.

My work spans one-on-one writing support, English language teaching, psycholinguistic research, and community engagement with culturally and linguistically diverse populations.

Fluent in Mandarin and English, I bring cross-cultural communication strengths to every classroom, lab, and community setting I enter.
